THE CALIFORNIA REPORT ON FRONTIER AI POLICY

Joint California Policy Working Group on AI Frontier Models

June 17, 2025

Artificial intelligence is advancing quickly, and its frontier models now carry benefits and risks
that policymakers must weigh together. This report reviews the evidence on those benefits and
risks and sets out principles that can guide state policy without prescribing particular rules.

The working group was convened by the Governor in September 2024. Its members come from
academia, industry and civil society, and it consulted widely before reaching its conclusions on
the questions it was asked to address.

1. Principles for policy
Policy should be informed by evidence and should adapt as the technology and the evidence change.
